evals.prompt: 把这张梨子照片做成一张有文字的松弛小画，你自己根据梨子的特点写一句短文案。
evals.expected_output: Two independently composed outputs by default: a text-integrated version whose short copy comes from visible pear traits, plus a text-free narrative version.
expectations: The output defaults to two finished versions: one 文字融入版 and one 无字叙事版.
The two versions use different composition, element relationships, and narrative priority rather than one layout with text toggled.
The output identifies the pear as the main photographic anchor and preserves its recognizable texture.
The copy is short and specifically derived from the pear rather than being a generic encouragement slogan.
Any homophone, personification, or joke is natural and relevant to the pear.
The text is assigned a compositional role such as annotation, path, dialogue, label, or object-attached phrase.
The lettering defaults to thin black naive handwriting, not heavy marker title lettering.
The prompt rejects standard fonts, calligraphy, rounded cute fonts, and neat typesetting.
The 无字叙事版 forbids all text, letters, numbers, labels, and random glyphs.

evals.prompt: 照片里有一杯葡萄饮料、几颗葡萄和一只手。把原图里的元素拆出来重新组合，文字不要只当标题。
evals.expected_output: A source-grounded element map with one main anchor, selected supporting photographic fragments, and short text woven into their relationships.
expectations: The output explicitly maps one main anchor and zero to three supporting source-derived elements.
The output keeps the drink and selected grape or hand fragments photographic rather than redrawing everything.
The output does not invent unsupported ingredients or product claims.
The text acts as a label, path, bridge, dialogue, or object-integrated phrase rather than a detached upper-left title.
The composition keeps generous negative space and avoids a sticker collage.
Doodles respond to the real geometry or relationship of the photographed elements.

evals.prompt: 字还是太像电脑字体了，而且排得很整齐。底图不要动，只改文字：细黑线、歪一点、大小不一、横画可以拉长。
evals.expected_output: A lettering-only correction that preserves the base and regenerates exact Chinese as one or more thin irregular handwriting layers.
expectations: The output keeps the existing photographic base unchanged.
The output treats the problem as glyph skeleton and placement regularity, not just texture.
The lettering correction uses thin black strokes, varied scale and tilt, irregular spacing, loose structures, and selected elongated horizontal strokes.
The correction rejects standard fonts, calligraphy, rounded cute handwriting, neat baselines, and perfect grids.
The output recommends regenerating only the affected short lettering layer or layers.
Exact spelling and readability remain required.

evals.prompt: 这张茶包照片做无字版，不要标题区，也不要任何乱码，只让小人和真实茶包发生一点关系。
evals.expected_output: A no-text narrative concept with a preserved photographic tea bag and one source-responsive primitive action.
expectations: The output selects 无字叙事版.
The prompt forbids all text, letters, numbers, labels, watermarks, and random glyphs.
The composition does not reserve an empty title zone.
The tea bag remains photographic and recognizable.
One clear action makes the tea bag function as a tool, terrain, ingredient, or stage.
The figure uses thin primitive black lines and does not become a cute mascot.

evals.prompt: 文案太普通了。根据这张带果皮、果肉和汁水的水果图，再想几个短一点、有点谐音或产品灵感感的说法。
evals.expected_output: Several concise source-derived candidates followed by selection of the strongest natural phrase, without forced wordplay or unsupported claims.
expectations: The output first identifies visible subject traits before drafting copy.
The output drafts three to five short candidates.
The preferred phrase is 2 to 8 Chinese characters, or split into two micro-phrases totaling at most 12 characters.
The selected copy is specific to the visible fruit traits.
Forced puns, generic slogans, rare characters, and unsupported product claims are rejected.
The output assigns the selected phrase a visual role in the composition.

evals.prompt: 准备发布这个 skill，检查公开路径、辅助脚本和包体是否可靠。
evals.expected_output: A release review that checks public paths, helper scripts, package hygiene, and the absence of unavailable private assets.
expectations: The output verifies that no unavailable private reference index or missing cutout is packaged or claimed as usable.
The output checks public files for absolute workstation paths, social-media filenames, credentials, and raw caches.
The output verifies that documented helper scripts exist and compile.
The output parses evals/evals.json and runs the skill validator.
The output warns against staging .DS_Store and unrelated generated outputs.
